interface: DeepSeek Harness SDK stdio JSON-RPC protocol
captureMethod: Deterministic synthetic traces authored from the exact published SDK protocol and SessionEventMap types. The minimal Profile logs system/message, settled assistant/message with an embedded stream, and assistant/attempt for uncommitted attempts. The npm integrity values fingerprint the inspected published artifacts.
redactionMethod: All identifiers, content, failures, timestamps and stream records are synthetic. No credentials, real prompts, host paths or provider traffic are captured.
